message:
Add an option to clamp the help wrap width

This is nice to have because on really wide screens the default
terminal-width wrapping can be a little unpleasant to read.

pr.title: Add an option to clamp the help wrap width
pr.body:
This is nice to have because on really wide screens the default
terminal-width wrapping can be a little unpleasant to read.

diff:
diff --git a/help.go b/help.go
index 2a9985f..0a1c469 100644
--- a/help.go
+++ b/help.go
@@ -51,6 +51,11 @@ type HelpOptions struct {
 
 	// Don't show the help associated with subcommands
 	NoExpandSubcommands bool
+
+	// Clamp the help wrap width to a value smaller than the terminal width.
+	// If this is set to a non-positive number, the terminal width is used; otherwise,
+	// the min of this value or the terminal width is used.
+	WrapUpperBound int
 }
 
 // Apply options to Kong as a configuration option.
@@ -367,9 +372,13 @@ type helpWriter struct {
 
 func newHelpWriter(ctx *Context, options HelpOptions) *helpWriter {
 	lines := []string{}
+	wrapWidth := guessWidth(ctx.Stdout)
+	if options.WrapUpperBound > 0 && wrapWidth > options.WrapUpperBound {
+		wrapWidth = options.WrapUpperBound
+	}
 	w := &helpWriter{
 		indent:        "",
-		width:         guessWidth(ctx.Stdout),
+		width:         wrapWidth,
 		lines:         &lines,
 		helpFormatter: ctx.Kong.helpFormatter,
 		HelpOptions:   options,
diff --git a/help_test.go b/help_test.go
index 566cf73..97c8d7b 100644
--- a/help_test.go
+++ b/help_test.go
@@ -708,3 +708,38 @@ test: error: missing flags: --flag=STRING
 `
 	require.Equal(t, expected, w.String())
 }
+
+func TestCustomWrap(t *testing.T) {
+	var cli struct {
+		Flag string `help:"A string flag with very long help that wraps a lot and is verbose and is really verbose."`
+	}
+
+	w := bytes.NewBuffer(nil)
+	app := mustNew(t, &cli,
+		kong.Name("test-app"),
+		kong.Description("A test app."),
+		kong.HelpOptions{
+			WrapUpperBound: 50,
+		},
+		kong.Writers(w, w),
+		kong.Exit(func(int) {}),
+	)
+
+	_, err := app.Parse([]string{"--help"})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	expected := `Usage: test-app
+
+A test app.
+
+Flags:
+  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive
+                       help.
+      --flag=STRING    A string flag with very
+                       long help that wraps a lot
+                       and is verbose and is
+                       really verbose.
+`
+	t.Log(w.String())
+	t.Log(expected)
+	require.Equal(t, expected, w.String())
+}

explanation.what: HelpOptions に WrapUpperBound フィールドを追加し、ヘルプ出力の折り返し幅を端末幅とこの上限値の小さい方にクランプできるようにした。newHelpWriter で guessWidth(ctx.Stdout) の結果に対し、WrapUpperBound が正の値かつ端末幅より小さければそちらを採用する。TestCustomWrap で WrapUpperBound: 50 を指定したときのヘルプ出力を検証している。
explanation.why: PR本文の通り、非常に広い画面では端末幅いっぱいにヘルプが折り返されると逆に読みにくくなるため、折り返し幅に上限を設けられるようにした。

highlights.note: guessWidth の結果を WrapUpperBound で上書きする箇所(wrapWidth の算出ロジック)
